name: use_syllable_001
why: Noto Sans Cham's subset has no glyph for U+AA29, so hb-shape draws .notdef there.

name: indic_special_cases_001
why: The terminal cuts Kannada ra, virama and ka into two clusters, because Unicode's grapheme rules join no Kannada conjunct, so the font cannot draw the reph.

name: use_indic3_001
why: The terminal cuts Kannada ka, virama and ra into two clusters, because Unicode's grapheme rules join no Kannada conjunct, so the font cannot draw the conjunct.

name: indic_syllable_001
why: The font kerns Tamil ta and virama against the superscript three after them, which is a cluster of its own.

name: indic_syllable_013
why: The font picks the first Tamil pa's form by the cluster after it.

name: myanmar_syllable_002
why: The terminal gives the Myanmar visarga and the tone mark after it clusters of their own, because Unicode's grapheme rules do not count either as a spacing mark, so the font draws each on a dotted circle.

name: use_javanese_013
why: The font places Javanese glyphs by the clusters around them, and the terminal cuts the text into five clusters.

name: use_javanese_028
why: The font places Javanese glyphs by the clusters around them, and the terminal cuts the text into thirteen clusters.

name: use_syllable_010
why: The terminal cuts the Brahmi conjuncts that the number joiner U+1107F makes, because Unicode's grapheme rules do not join them.

name: use_010
why: The terminal cuts Newa's conjuncts, because Unicode's grapheme rules join no Newa conjunct.

name: indic_syllable_006
why: The text is Gurmukhi udaat alone, which hb-shape draws on a dotted circle.

name: khmer_misc_090
why: The text is two Khmer coengs alone, which hb-shape draws on dotted circles.
